case.whole_comparison: Wilson supplies a complete two-part prayer asking that the repeatedly received holy gifts be handled with sincere devotion and received with a faithful mind. PiusSecret keeps both linked predicates, their order, request frame and ending, but adds an offering preface, recasts the sacramental object, inserts Pius' intercession, omits semper, and reassigns the whole from postcommunion to Secret.
case.positive: This is a concrete old whole with the distinctive paired petition intact, not merely unrelated fragments. The alterations can be argued as a functional adjustment to Secret and saint intercession using conventional liturgical wording. It therefore warrants one bounded exact whole-expression merits review without new acquisition.
case.contrary: The selected modern whole is not a one-name or one-functional-word substitution. Its new opening, object phrase, intercessory insertion, omission and change of liturgical role may form an expressive adaptation. Wilson proves the central petition is old, but does not establish the complete modern arrangement or its freedom from protection. No blanket sibling decision reaches it.
case.prior_gap_disposition: Modern1954/1955 formulary remains held; older conventional phrases do not by themselves clear the complete modern prayer.

study_English.text: Graciously receive our offerings, we beseech Thee, O Lord, and grant that, through the intercession of Saint Pius, Supreme Pontiff, we may celebrate these divine mysteries with sincere devotion and receive them with a faithful mind. Through our Lord.
